story.title: FarMart Turns EBITDA Profitable in Q4 FY26, Hits Rs 3,600 Crore Run Rate With AI-Powered Agri Workflows
story.summary: Agrifood platform FarMart has reached EBITDA profitability in Q4 FY26 and achieved a Rs 3,600 crore annualised revenue run rate, attributing its 50 percent year-on-year growth to deeper farmer wallet share, stronger supply chain networks, and AI-powered workflows across its operations. The decade-old platform connects farmers, input suppliers, and agri-businesses, with AI now embedded in procurement, logistics, and advisory services. The milestone is significant for India's agritech sector, which has seen multiple high-profile shutdowns in recent years.
